messages.author: 0f089686f8ad364c
messages.subject: mqmextractmarkers()
parts:
Hi,

I have several problems using MQM for my data. The analysis as such is running, even thought the mqmaugument is not running, but fill.geno does.
So, afterwards I wanted to extract my markers like it is described in the help. So far my skript looks like this:

library(qtl)
I_80_fam3_QTL <-read.cross("csv",file="/home/franziska/Dokumente/MasterBio/Masterarbeit/Daten/Quant_Daten/R/qtl_Fam3_AA_BB.csv",genotypes=c("AA","BB"),na.strings="-",alleles = c("A","B"))
geno.image(I_80_fam3_QTL)

multitrait <- fill.geno(I_80_fam3_QTL)
geno.image(multitrait)
result <- mqmscan(multitrait, pheno.col=1:4)

real_markers <- mqmextractmarkers(result)

A strange error returns when I try to extract the real markers, which is; "error in mqmextractmarkers(result) :
  Wrong type of result file, please supply a valid scanone (from MQM) object. "

But my object "result" is from mqmscan. So I dont know what is going on with this.
I hope anybody could help?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] mqmextractmarkers()
parts:
Maybe try running the code again from the beginning? I suspect that something got corrupted.

mqmextractmarkers is looking for the result object to be of class "scanone", and I can't see how the output of mqmscan could be different from that.

karl
